newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from early losses on scant buying of the greenback and closed at 42.5250/5350 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday, dealers said.

The taka was quoted weaker at 42.5350/5450 to the dollar in early trade on expectations of higher demand from private banks. "But finally only a few of them (private banks) came and bought small amount," said one dealer.
Interbank call money rates finished at 6.5 to 7.0 percent, down from Monday's 6.5 to 7.5 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
